2607.10677.title: From Self-Attention to Connection Laplacian: A Unified Operator View of Transformers
2607.10677.paper_summary: Self-attention is a ubiquitous primitive in modern sequence models, yet its operator-level geometry is only partially understood. We view a token sequence as a vector field over the token-position graph and identify attention as a connection walk: messages are aggregated by a nonnegative walk matrix while being transported along each edge by a learned linear map. Within this framework, we prove that single-head attention (SHA) is exactly a connection propagation step with constant transport, and that multi-head attention (MHA) is exactly a single edge-dependent connection walk whose effective transport is an attention-gated mixture of headwise transports. We further clarify the conditions under which the corresponding generator reduces to a random-walk connection Laplacian, highlighting the roles of stochasticity, reversibility, and metric-compatible transports. Empirically, we find that trained Transformers across scales (from 124M to 8B) and structures (encoder/decoder) exhibit geometric structure consistent with our theory: effective attention graphs converge to stable geometric operators in deeper layers, learned transports self-organize into approximate scaled isometries, and both phenomena strengthen consistently with scale. Overall, the paper provides a precise connection-walk formalism that links self-attention to classical geometric operators, along with a set of operator-level tools for analyzing transformer models from a geometric perspective.
2607.10677.paper_summary_zh: 自注意力是現代序列模型中的一個普遍原始概念，但其算子級幾何結構僅部分被理解。<lb/>我們將令牌序列視為令牌位置圖上的向量場，並將注意力識別為一種連接行走：消息通過一個非負的行走矩陣聚合，同時沿著每個邊由學習的線性映射進行傳輸。<lb/>在這個框架內，我們證明單頭注意力（SHA）恰好是一個具有恆定傳輸的連接傳播步驟，而多頭注意力（MHA）恰好是一個單邊依賴的連接行走，其有效傳輸是頭部傳輸的注意力閘混合。<lb/>我們進一步澄清了相應生成器簡化為隨機行走連接拉普拉斯算子的條件，突顯了隨機性、可逆性和度量相容傳輸的角色。<lb/>從實證上看，我們發現不同規模（從124M到8B）和結構（編碼器/解碼器）的訓練Transformer展現出與我們理論一致的幾何結構：有效的注意力圖在更深層次上收斂到穩定的幾何算子，學習的傳輸自我組織成近似的縮放等距映射，並且這兩種現象隨著規模的增長而一致加強。<lb/>總體而言，本文提供了一個精確的連接行走形式主義，將自注意力與經典幾何算子聯繫起來，以及一組從幾何角度分析Transformer模型的算子級工具。
